shortDescription: Manage nic tags on SmartOS systems

options.name: etherstub
options.description: Specifies that the nic tag is attached to a created O(etherstub). Parameter O(etherstub) is mutually exclusive with both O(mtu), and O(mac).

options.name: force
options.description: When O(state=absent) this switch uses the C(-f) parameter and delete the nic tag regardless of existing VMs.

options.name: mac
options.description: Specifies the O(mac) address to attach the nic tag to when not creating an O(etherstub). Parameters O(mac) and O(etherstub) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Specifies the size of the O(mtu) of the desired nic tag. Parameters O(mtu) and O(etherstub) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or delete a SmartOS nic tag.
